submitted_by: Inspector R. Naidu, Telangana Cybercrime Unit
examiner_credentials: M.Sc. Forensic Science, Certified QD Examiner (CDFE)
purpose: To determine whether the submitted COVID vaccination certificate is genuine or fabricated

typography.font_inconsistency: Arial used in Ministry of Health header; Times New Roman found in patient name and date of birth fields — inconsistent with a single-source printed document
typography.kerning_detail: Irregular letter spacing of 2.1pt observed in the date field; genuine CoWIN certificates show uniform 0pt kerning throughout
typography.baseline_shift: 2.3mm downward deviation in the Date of Birth row compared to adjacent printed lines
typography.resolution_mismatch: Patient name section shows 72 DPI print artifacts; rest of document prints at 300 DPI — indicates name field was inserted from a different source

signature.pressure_variation: Uniform pen pressure throughout signature — inconsistent with natural human handwriting which shows heavier downstrokes
signature.pen_lift_detail: Unnatural pen lift detected mid-stroke in the 'S' character, consistent with tracing behaviour
signature.tremor_note: Complete absence of natural speed tremor in connecting strokes — genuine signatures show micro-tremors at 20x magnification

paper.gsm_note: Measured paper weight is 80 GSM; official CoWIN certificates are printed on 100 GSM paper per NIC specification
paper.watermark_note: No security watermark detected under transmitted light; genuine certificates bear 'Government of India' watermark
paper.uv_note: Paper shows bright white fluorescence under 365nm UV (copy paper characteristic); genuine CoWIN paper shows controlled blue-white fluorescence

ink.spread_pattern: Laser toner fusion pattern detected across entire document including signature field; genuine CoWIN certificates use inkjet printing for variable data fields
ink.age_inconsistency: Ink solvent retention test indicates printing occurred within 30 days of examination; certificate claims to be dated 14 months ago
ink.toner_vs_inkjet: Toner detected where inkjet expected — printing process does not match NIC-specified production method

digital_metadata.creation_tool: Adobe Acrobat 2021 (21.0.0.29898) — genuine CoWIN certificates are generated by the NIC CoWIN backend and show 'CoWIN' as creator
digital_metadata.edit_note: Three post-creation modifications detected in XMP modification history; a genuine single-issue certificate has no modification events
digital_metadata.geolocation_detail: Embedded timezone metadata shows UTC+5:30 but GPS coordinates (if present) correspond to a location outside India
digital_metadata.signature_note: Digital signature certificate chain is self-signed and cannot be verified against NIC's certificate authority; ByteRange does not cover full file

seal.impression_quality: Seal impression shows uneven ink distribution — genuine rubber stamps produce uniform impression
seal.font_in_seal: Seal text uses Arial Narrow; genuine Ministry seals use a proprietary government font
seal.dimensions_note: Seal diameter measures 38mm; official Ministry of Health seal is 42mm per reference specimen

reference_specimen_note: One genuine CoWIN certificate provided by NIC for comparison purposes
